fixes.what: After installing custom validation handlers, set form.noValidate = true so every submission reaches checkValidity(), reportValidity() and explicit invalid-field focus.
fixes.why: Native interactive validation currently prevents the submit event on invalid forms, making the intended focus fallback unreachable.

fixes.where: assets/js/site.js — ghostObserver and desktopQuery change handler
fixes.what: Extract destination visibility calculation into a shared function and run it on both observer updates and breakpoint changes.
fixes.why: hideAtDestination retains the previous breakpoint's photo-row state until another intersection notification arrives.

fixes.what: Preserve the additional right clearance on nested text containers, including About's 'What anar means' block; verify text bounds against the tab at 390px.
fixes.why: The more-specific nested-container padding reset overrides the mobile clearance rule, allowing text into the tab's reserved area.

fixes.where: assets/css/site.css — mobile navigation enhancement; assets/js/canopy.js — fitHero()
fixes.what: Measure cold-load layout shifts with delayed scripts and fonts; reserve consistent header space before nav-ready and calibrate the initial hero-content estimate to minimize corrective resizing.
fixes.why: The fallback navigation initially occupies normal flow, then disappears into a fixed header; later hero measurements can move subsequent content again.
